Commodore 64 for Analogue Pocket (MyC64)
Pocket Shortcuts Edition

GAMEPAD SHORTCUTS:
------------------
Normal (No modifier):
* Face A: Fire 1 (Joystick)
* Face B: Jump (Joystick UP) + Fire 2
* Face X: Space
* Face Y: Return
* Select: Toggle Virtual Keyboard / In-Core OSD

L Modifier held (Joystick disconnected while held):
* L + D-pad Up:    F1
* L + D-pad Right: F3
* L + D-pad Down:  F5
* L + D-pad Left:  F7
* L + Face A:      Space
* L + Face B:      Return
* L + Face X:      Run/Stop
* L + Face Y:      1 (1 Player select)

L + R Modifier held together:
* L + R + D-pad Up:    F2 (Shift+F1)
* L + R + D-pad Right: F4 (Shift+F3)
* L + R + D-pad Down:  F6 (Shift+F5)
* L + R + D-pad Left:  F8 (Shift+F7)
* L + R + Face A:      Space
* L + R + Face B:      N (No)
* L + R + Face X:      Y (Yes)
* L + R + Face Y:      2 (2 Players select)

SUPPORTED FORMATS:
* .CRT (Cartridge - Magic Desk, EasyFlash)
* .PRG (Crunched programs via Load & Start PRG)
Place games in Assets/c64/common/
